verses.en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
verses.pt: E Coré, filho de Izar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi; e Datã e Abirão, filhos de Eliabe; e Om, filho de Pelete, dos filhos de Rúben, tomaram gente,
verses.en_web: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
verses.en_bbe: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Pallu, the son of Reuben, made themselves ready,

verses.en: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.pt: E levantaram-se contra Moisés com duzentos e cinquenta homens dos filhos de Israel, príncipes da congregação, dos do conselho, homens de renome;
verses.en_web: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
verses.en_bbe: And came before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty chiefs of the people, men of good name who had a place in the meeting of the people.

verses.en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?
verses.pt: E se juntaram contra Moisés e Arão, e lhes disseram: Basta-vos, porque toda a congregação, todos eles são santos, e em meio deles está o SENHOR: por que, pois, vos levantais vós sobre a congregação do SENHOR?
verses.en_web: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”
verses.en_bbe: They came together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, You take overmuch on yourselves, seeing that all the people are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them; why then have you put yourselves in authority over the people of the Lord?

verses.en: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.pt: E quando o ouviu Moisés, lançou-se sobre seu rosto;
verses.en_web: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses, hearing this, went down on his face;

verses.en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.pt: E falou a Coré e a todo o seu grupo, dizendo: Amanhã mostrará o SENHOR quem é seu, e ao santo o fará chegar a si; e ao que ele escolher, ele o achegará a si.
verses.en_web: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to Korah and his band, In the morning the Lord will make clear who are his, and who is holy, and who may come near him: the man of his selection will be caused to come near him.

verses.en: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.pt: Fazei isto: tomai incensários, Coré e todo o seu grupo:
verses.en_web: Do this: take censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.en_bbe: So do this: let Korah and all his band take vessels for burning perfumes;

verses.en: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.pt: E ponde fogo neles, e ponde neles incenso diante do SENHOR amanhã; e será que o homem a quem o SENHOR escolher, aquele será o santo: basta-vos isto, filhos de Levi.
verses.en_web: and put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”
verses.en_bbe: And put spices on the fire in them before the Lord tomorrow; then the man marked out by the Lord will be holy: you take overmuch on yourselves, you sons of Levi.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.pt: Disse mais Moisés a Coré: Ouvi agora, filhos de Levi:
verses.en_web: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to Korah, Give ear now, you sons of Levi:

verses.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.pt: Vos é pouco que o Deus de Israel vos haja apartado da congregação de Israel, fazendo-vos achegar a si para que ministrasses no serviço do tabernáculo do SENHOR, e estivésseis diante da congregação para ministrar-lhes?
verses.en_web: Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
verses.en_bbe: Does it seem only a small thing to you that the God of Israel has made you separate from the rest of Israel, letting you come near himself to do the work of the House of the Lord, and to take your place before the people to do what has to be done for them;

verses.en: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.pt: E que te fez aproximar a ti, e a todos os teus irmãos os filhos de Levi contigo; para que procureis também o sacerdócio?
verses.en_web: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
verses.en_bbe: Letting you, and all your brothers the sons of Levi, come near to him? and would you now be priests?

verses.en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.pt: Portanto, tu e todo o teu grupo sois os que vos juntais contra o SENHOR: pois Arão, que é para que contra ele murmureis?
verses.en_web: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you murmur against him?”
verses.en_bbe: So you and all your band have come together against the Lord; and Aaron, who is he, that you are crying out against him?

verses.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.pt: E enviou Moisés a chamar a Datã e Abirão, filhos de Eliabe; mas eles responderam: Não iremos lá:
verses.en_web: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: and they said, We will not come up:

verses.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.pt: É pouco que nos tenhas feito vir de uma terra que destila leite e mel, para fazer-nos morrer no deserto, mas que também te faças senhor de nós autoritariamente?
verses.en_web: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?
verses.en_bbe: Is it not enough that you have taken us from a land flowing with milk and honey, to put us to death in the waste land, but now you are desiring to make yourself a chief over us?

verses.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.pt: Nem tampouco nos puseste tu em terra que flua leite e mel, nem nos deste propriedades de terras e vinhas: hás de arrancar os olhos destes homens? Não subiremos.
verses.en_web: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
verses.en_bbe: And more than this, you have not taken us into a land flowing with milk and honey, or given us a heritage of fields and vine-gardens: will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up.

verses.en: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.pt: Então Moisés se irou em grande maneira, e disse ao SENHOR: Não olhes a sua oferta: nem ainda um asno tomei deles, nem a nenhum deles fiz mal.
verses.en_web: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses was very angry, and said to the Lord, Give no attention to their offering: not one of their asses have I taken, or done wrong to any of them.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.pt: Depois disse Moisés a Coré: Tu e todo o teu grupo, ponde-vos amanhã diante do SENHOR; tu, e eles, e Arão:
verses.en_web: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to Korah, You and all your band are to come before the Lord tomorrow, you and they and Aaron:

verses.en: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.pt: E tomai cada um seu incensário, e ponde incenso neles, e achegai diante do SENHOR cada um seu incensário: duzentos e cinquenta incensários: tu também, e Arão, cada um com seu incensário.
verses.en_web: Each man take his censer, and put incense on them, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer.”
verses.en_bbe: And let every man take a vessel for burning perfumes, and put sweet spices in them; let every man take his vessel before the Lord, two hundred and fifty vessels; you and Aaron and everyone with his vessel.

verses.en: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.pt: E tomaram cada um seu incensário, e puseram neles fogo, e lançaram neles incenso, e puseram-se à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho com Moisés e Arão.
verses.en_web: They each took his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
verses.en_bbe: So every man took his vessel and they put fire in them, with spices, and came to the door of the Tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.

verses.en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.pt: Já Coré havia feito juntar contra eles toda a congregação à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho: então a glória do SENHOR apareceu a toda a congregação.
verses.en_web: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.
verses.en_bbe: And Korah made all the people come together against them to the door of the Tent of meeting: and the glory of the Lord was seen by all the people.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.pt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.pt: Apartai-vos dentre esta congregação, e os consumirei em um momento.
verses.en_web: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
verses.en_bbe: Come out from among this people, so that I may send sudden destruction on them.

verses.en: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.pt: E eles se lançaram sobre seus rostos, e disseram: Deus, Deus dos espíritos de toda carne, não é um homem o que pecou? E te irarás tu contra toda a congregação?
verses.en_web: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”
verses.en_bbe: Then falling down on their faces they said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, because of one man's sin will your wrath be moved against all the people?

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.pt: Fala à congregação, dizendo: Apartai-vos de em derredor da tenda de Coré, Datã, e Abirão.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”
verses.en_bbe: Say to the people, Come away from the tent of Korah Dathan, and Abiram.

verses.en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.pt: E Moisés se levantou, e foi a Datã e Abirão; e os anciãos de Israel foram atrás dele.
verses.en_web: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the responsible men of Israel went with him.

verses.en: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.pt: E ele falou à congregação, dizendo: Apartai-vos agora das tendas destes ímpios homens, e não toqueis nenhuma coisa sua, porque não pereçais em todos os seus pecados.
verses.en_web: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the people, Come away now from the tents of these evil men, without touching anything of theirs, or you may be taken in the punishment of their sins.

verses.en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.pt: E apartaram-se das tendas de Coré, de Datã, e de Abirão em derredor: e Datã e Abirão saíram e puseram-se às portas de suas tendas, com suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas crianças.
verses.en_web: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
verses.en_bbe: So on every side they went away from the tent of Korah Dathan, and Abiram: and Dathan and Abiram came out to the door of their tents, with their wives and their sons and their little ones.

verses.en: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
verses.pt: E disse Moisés: Em isto conhecereis que o SENHOR me enviou para que fizesse todas estas coisas: que não de meu coração as fiz.
verses.en_web: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said, Now you will see that the Lord has sent me to do all these works, and I have not done them of myself.

verses.en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.
verses.pt: Se como morrem todos os homens morrerem estes, ou se forem eles visitados à maneira de todos os homens, o SENHOR não me enviou.
verses.en_web: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.
verses.en_bbe: If these men have the common death of men, or if the natural fate of all men overtakes them, then the Lord has not sent me.

verses.en: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
verses.pt: Mas se o SENHOR fizer uma nova coisa, e a terra abrir sua boca, e os tragar com todas suas coisas, e descerem vivos ao Xeol, então conhecereis que estes homens irritaram ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up, with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: But if the Lord does something new, opening the earth to take them in, with everything which is theirs, and they go down living into the underworld, then it will be clear to you that the Lord has not been honoured by these men.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
verses.pt: E aconteceu, que em acabando ele de falar todas estas palavras, rompeu-se a terra que estava debaixo deles:
verses.en_web: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
verses.en_bbe: And while these words were on his lips, the earth under them was parted in two;

verses.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.pt: E abriu a terra sua boca, e tragou-os a eles, e a suas casas, e a todos os homens de Coré, e a todos os seus pertences.
verses.en_web: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
verses.en_bbe: And the earth, opening her mouth, took them in, with their families, and all the men who were joined to Korah, and their goods.

verses.en: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.pt: E eles, com tudo o que tinham, desceram vivos ao Xeol, a a terra os cobriu, e pereceram do meio da congregação.
verses.en_web: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
verses.en_bbe: So they and all theirs went down living into the underworld, and the earth was shut over them, and they were cut off from among the meeting of the people.

verses.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.pt: E todo Israel, os que estavam em derredor deles, fugiram ao grito deles; porque diziam: Não nos trague também a terra.
verses.en_web: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
verses.en_bbe: And all Israel round about them went in flight at their cry, For fear, said they, that we go down into the heart of the earth.

verses.en: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.pt: E saiu fogo do SENHOR, e consumiu os duzentos e cinquenta homens que ofereciam o incenso.
verses.en_web: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
verses.en_bbe: Then fire came out from the Lord, burning up the two hundred and fifty men who were offering the perfume.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.pt: Dize a Eleazar, filho de Arão sacerdote, que tome os incensários do meio do incêndio, e derrame mais ali o fogo; porque são santificados:
verses.en_web: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,
verses.en_bbe: Say to Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, that he is to take out of the flames the vessels with the perfumes in them, turning the fire out of them, for they are holy;

verses.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Os incensários destes pecadores contra suas almas: e farão deles placas estendidas para cobrir o altar: porquanto ofereceram com eles diante do SENHOR, são santificados; e serão por sinal aos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: And let the vessels of those men, who with their lives have made payment for their sin, be hammered out into plates as a cover for the altar; for they have been offered before the Lord and are holy; so that they may be a sign to the children of Israel.

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.pt: E o sacerdote Eleazar tomou os incensários de bronze com que os queimados haviam oferecido; e estenderam-nos para cobrir o altar,
verses.en_web: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
verses.en_bbe: So Eleazar the priest took the brass vessels which had been offered by those who were burned up, and they were hammered out to make a cover for the altar:

verses.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.pt: Em memorial aos filhos de Israel que nenhum estranho que não seja da descendência de Arão, chegue a oferecer incenso diante do SENHOR, para que não seja como Coré, e como seu grupo; segundo se o disse o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.
verses.en_web: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah, and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.
verses.en_bbe: To be a sign, kept in memory for ever by the children of Israel, that no man who is not of the seed of Aaron has the right of burning spices before the Lord, so that he may not be like Korah and his band: as the Lord said to him by the mouth of Moses.

verses.en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
verses.pt: No dia seguinte toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel murmurou contra Moisés e Arão, dizendo: Vós haveis matado ao povo do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”
verses.en_bbe: But on the day after, all the children of Israel made an outcry against Moses and against Aaron, saying, You have put to death the Lord's people.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando se juntou a congregação contra Moisés e Arão, olharam até o tabernáculo do testemunho, e eis que a nuvem o havia coberto, e apareceu a glória do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, They looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.
verses.en_bbe: Now when the people had come together against Moses and Aaron, looking in the direction of the Tent of meeting, they saw the cloud covering it, and the glory of the Lord came before their eyes.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.pt: E vieram Moisés e Arão diante do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.en_web: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of meeting.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.pt: Apartai-vos do meio desta congregação, e os consumirei em um momento. E eles se lançaram sobre seus rostos.
verses.en_web: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
verses.en_bbe: Come out from among this people, so that I may send sudden destruction on them. And they went down on their faces.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
verses.pt: E disse Moisés A Arão: Toma o incensário, e põe nele fogo do altar, e sobre ele põe incenso, e vai logo à congregação, e faze expiação por eles; porque o furor saiu de diante da face do SENHOR: a mortandade começou.
verses.en_web: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire from off the altar in it, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to Aaron, Take your vessel and put in it fire from the altar, and sweet spices, and take it quickly into the meeting of the people, and make them free from sin: for wrath has gone out from the Lord, and the disease is starting.

verses.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.pt: Então tomou Arão o incensário, como Moisés disse, e correu em meio da congregação: e eis que a mortandade havia começado no povo: e ele pôs incenso, e fez expiação pelo povo.
verses.en_web: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
verses.en_bbe: And at the words of Moses, Aaron took his vessel, and went running among the people; and even then the disease had made a start among them; and he put spices in his vessel to take away the sin of the people.

verses.en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.pt: E pôs-se entre os mortos e os vivos, e cessou a mortandade.
verses.en_web: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.en_bbe: And he took his place between the dead and the living: and the disease was stopped.

verses.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.pt: E os que morreram naquela mortandade foram catorze mil e setecentos, sem os mortos pelo negócio de Coré.
verses.en_web: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.
verses.en_bbe: Now fourteen thousand, seven hundred deaths were caused by that disease, in addition to those who came to their end because of what Korah had done.

verses.en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.pt: Depois se voltou Arão a Moisés à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, quando a mortandade havia cessado.
verses.en_web: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.
verses.en_bbe: Then Aaron went back to Moses to the door of the Tent of meeting: and the disease came to a stop.
